Steps to reproduce in-channel flicker issue.
1. Open serge, log into "Papa-Foxtrot" as log in as "Blue - POLAD". 
2. Go to "Blue COA" channel.
3. Click on a COA that is `Pending Review`
4. Click on `Claim` - it will open in editor.  Make slight modification to COA name.
5. Open serge in another window. log into `Papa-Foxtrot` as "Blue - Senior Blue". 
6. Go to "Blue COA" channel
7. Open COA that is `Pending Review`
8. Click on `Claim` - and notice the `POLAD` window flicker/redraw. 

![Recording](https://i.gyazo.com/203d60b4b722d4100f6e521a36edf911.gif)

Thanks @lilitkarapetyan - there remains [one issue](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/runs/4948383980?check_suite_focus=true#step:6:2229).  I tried to resolve it by re-creating the `jest snapshot`, but that didn't fix it.
